ZinUnsafe.Purpose: Unsafe blocks mark operations that intentionally bypass normal static or runtime safety guarantees. Unsafe does not disable unrelated checks automatically.

RequiredFor.Operation: Pointer casts which may violate provenance/type validity
Inline assembly that can observe or mutate machine state outside declared safe abstractions
Raw target syscall primitives exposed by std.os.raw

ZinUnsafe.NotRequiredFor: Normal pointer dereference of a statically valid pointer, slice indexing, checked casts, normal extern calls, atomics, and safe std.os/std.posix wrappers.
ZinUnsafe.Rule: Unsafe is a lexical permission boundary, not a runtime mode and not a blanket optimization flag.
